paite: Huan, a thillat lemna thillat kithoihna a hih a, bawng hon lak a a lat leh, TOUPA ma ah gensiatbei a lan ding ahi.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings; if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Yahweh.

paite: A thillat lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpibul ah a gou ding: huan, Aron tapa, siampute'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uh ahi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons, the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

paite: Huan, lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a lan ding a: a sungkua thau leh a gilboh tengteng leh,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: A kal nihte leh a tuam thau a phuk chin a om leh a sin tuam lam, a kalte toh kigawm in a suah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Huan, Aron tapate'n maitam ah, mei a sing om tung a haltum thillat tungah a hal ding uhi: huai bel TOUPA a ding a gimlim tak, mei a thillat ahi.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a ding a a thillat belam hon lak ate a hihleh, a nu leng hita hen aw, a pa zong hita leh, gensiatbei a lat ding ahi.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

paite: A thillat a belamnou a lat leh TOUPA ma ah a lan ding a:
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

paite: A thillat lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, kihoupihna puan inn kongpi ah a gou ding: huan, Aron tapate'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uhi.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Huchi in lemna thillat kithoihna ate, TOUPA ding a mei a thillat a lan ding a: a thaute, a mei thau mahmah a tawn in, a kawngguh tan in a la vek ding a; a sungkua thaute, a gil boh tengtengte,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

paite: A kal nihte leh a phuk chin a om a tuam thau leh a sin tuam a lap, a kalte nangawn toh a suah ding ahi
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Huan, siampu in huai maitam ah a hal ding ahi: huai bel TOUPA a dia mei a thillat nek ding annsiah ahi.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: A thillat kel a hih leh TOUPA ma ah a lan ding a:
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh:

paite: Huan, a lu tungah a khut a koih ding a, kihoupihna puan in kong ah a gou ding a; huan, Aron tapate'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uh ahi.
english: and he shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Huan, huai a a thillat pen a lan ding a, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat tak; a sungkua thau leh a gilboh tengteng leh,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: A kal nihte leh a phuk chin a om a tuam thau leh a sin tuam lam, a kalte toh nangawn in a suah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Huan, huai pen siampu in maitam ah a hal ding ahi: gimlim ding a mei a thillat nek ding annsiah ahi a; a thau tengteng TOUPA a tuam ahi.Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei chih na suante uh ding a banban in na omna phot uah khantawn a thuseh ahi ding, chi in, chi in.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

paite: Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei chih na suante uh ding a banban in na omna phot uah khantawn a thuseh ahi ding, chi in, chi in.
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”
